wines.place: Rully 村庄级；黏土石灰岩土壤。
wines.method: 人工采收、整串气囊压榨；12°C 静置 24 小时。桶与 demi-muids 中完成酒精及苹果酸乳酸发酵；轻烘烤法国桶 15 个月，20% 新桶，定期搅桶。

wines.vintageScope: 页面列 2023；工艺作为酒款技术基线，不视为所有年份保证。

en.place: Village Rully on clay-limestone soils.
en.method: Hand harvest, whole-bunch pneumatic press, 24-hour settling at 12°C; alcoholic and malolactic fermentation in barrels/demi-muids. Fifteen months in lightly toasted French oak, 20% new, with regular bâtonnage.
en.detail: Producer suggests 11–13°C and white meat, poultry or fish.
en.vintageScope: Page lists 2023; process is treated as a label baseline, not a guarantee for all vintages.

en.method: Hand-picked and whole-bunch pressed; 24-hour settling at 12°C, then alcoholic and malolactic fermentation in barrel. Eighteen months in lightly toasted French oak, 30% new.
en.detail: Producer suggests 11–13°C with shellfish.
en.vintageScope: Page lists 2023; technical text is not explicitly limited to that vintage.

wines.name: Rully Rouge
wines.place: Rully 村庄级，黏土石灰岩土壤。
wines.method: 人工采收、小筐运输、分选及去梗；10°C 冷浸，8–10 天每日压帽，再浸渍 3–5 天。完成苹果酸乳酸发酵；法国桶 15 个月，20% 新桶。

wines.vintageScope: 页面同时列 2018、2022、2023；工艺为酒款基线。

en.method: Hand-picked into small crates, sorted and destemmed; cold soak at 10°C, daily punch-downs for 8–10 days and a further 3–5-day maceration. Complete malolactic conversion; 15 months in French oak, 20% new.

en.vintageScope: Page lists 2018, 2022 and 2023; method is a label-level baseline.

en.intro: A fourth-generation Rully estate of the Belleville family, celebrating its centenary in 2026 from André Belleville's 1926 purchase of the cellars.
en.scope: Source-reviewed producer and Rully wine records; label-level technical baselines are separated from identified vintages.

sections.title: History and identity
sections.text: Henry Belleville shifted towards still wines; Christian took over in 1982. Historic Manigley and Chauchoux vineyards are now combined; this estate is not merged with the separate Domaine Belleville profile.

sections.title: Vineyards
sections.text: The estate website states 21 ha, versus about 20 ha in BIVB's profile; this is total estate area including non-Rully wines.

sections.title: Winemaking and ageing
sections.text: The estate grows, makes and markets its wines. Its general method specifies 8–10 months in oak and cellars dating to 1826; individual new-oak percentages are not published.

technicalLimitations: No dated analytical data or confirmed photo reuse permissions were available for every new wine; no such claims were invented.
David Lefort's own product pages identify bottles, grapes and vintages but do not publish full vinification specifications. La Chaume 2019 importer specifications are retained separately.
Sylvain & Lucie Ponsot's portfolio distinguishes multiple vessels for Vauvry; these are separate cuvées, not duplicate names.
Renaissance French primary technical sheets are used for farming/identity: the English promotional text's unsupported biodynamic wording is not adopted.
Census types combine BIVB business categories with explicit entity names. A tasting cellar label alone does not establish the business owns vineyards.
